statement: Lakshmi Yoga (a strong, angularly or trinally placed 9th lord, alongside a well-placed Ascendant lord) is traditionally read as carrying prosperity, good fortune, and an ethical, generous character — one of the more prestigious named wealth combinations.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
